description: This file defines the DateTimePlus class, a wrapper around PHP's DateTime class with enhanced initialization options, error handling, and formatting capabilities, used within Drupal's component utility library.

classes.name: DateTimePlus
classes.description: A class extending PHP's DateTime with additional features such as flexible creation methods, error tracking, and custom formatting, used for date handling in Drupal.

methods.name: createFromDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTimePlus instance from an existing DateTimeInterface object.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DateTimePlus instance from an array of date parts, with validation.

methods.name: createFromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a DateTimePlus instance from a UNIX timestamp.

methods.name: createFromFormat
methods.description: Creates a DateTimePlus instance from a specific date format and string, with optional validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a DateTimePlus object with specified time, timezone, and settings, handling errors.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string including timezone name.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the underlying DateTime object, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two DateTimePlus objects.

methods.name: __callStatic
methods.description: Delegates static method calls to PHP's DateTime class.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Deep clones the internal DateTime object.

methods.name: prepareTime
methods.description: Prepares and possibly modifies the input time value before use.

methods.name: prepareTimezone
methods.description: Prepares and validates the timezone object or string.

methods.name: prepareFormat
methods.description: Prepares the date format string.

methods.name: checkErrors
methods.description: Checks for errors and warnings from PHP's DateTime and updates error list.

methods.name: hasErrors
methods.description: Returns true if there are any errors.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages.

methods.name: arrayToISO
methods.description: Converts an array of date parts into an ISO date string.

methods.name: prepareArray
methods.description: Completes an array of date parts, filling missing values.

methods.name: checkArray
methods.description: Validates an array of date parts for correctness.

methods.name: datePad
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zeros to a specified size.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the date according to a specified format string.

methods.name: setDefaultDateTime
methods.description: Sets the default time to noon for date-only data.

methods.name: getPhpDateTime
methods.description: Returns a clone of the internal PHP DateTime object.
